text: Gomɗii Yuusufu ardaniino on ko adii, e hujjaaji ɓannginɗi wootinɗingol Allah, kono on seeraano e sikkitagol fenna, kon ko o addani on. Haa nde o faatinoo, ɓeyduɗon sikkitagol, wi'uɗon. Allah nultataa Nulaaɗo goo, ɓaawo makko. Ko wano majjirɗon nii e goonga kan, Allah majjinirta kala yawtoowo keeri Allah ɗin, sikkitiiɗo e gootaaku Makko.
